mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_agent_privacy_object (workspace_id, operation_key, object_key, deletion_queue_id, disposition) VALUES (#{workspaceId}, #{operationKey}, #{objectKey}, #{queueId}, 'pending') ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE deletion_queue_id = VALUES(deletion_queue_id), disposition = 'pending', retained_attachment_id = NULL, completed_at = NULL

INSERT INTO ai_agent_privacy_object (workspace_id, operation_key, object_key, disposition, retained_attachment_id, completed_at) VALUES (#{workspaceId}, #{operationKey}, #{objectKey}, 'retained', #{attachmentId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE deletion_queue_id = NULL, disposition = 'retained', retained_attachment_id = VALUES(retained_attachment_id), completed_at = VALUES(completed_at)
